intro: Pause, unwind, and savour every moment with our Pause dining chair. With its supportive backrest and sleek profile, it turns your dining area into a haven of style, comfort, and instant connections.

features.title: Strong and dependable
features.text: Built from solid rubberwood, our chair is strong and durable, standing up to everyday use with ease.

features.title: Plush cushioned seat
features.text: Settle in and stay awhile. The fabric-upholstered seat is soft, supportive, and perfect for long meals or lively gatherings.

features.title: High back for support
features.text: Long dinners just got comfier. A tall, supportive backrest keeps your posture in check while you savour every bite.

features.title: Perfect pairing
features.text: Designed to perfectly match our Primo dining table, creating a cohesive and polished look just for you.

features.title: Mahogany elegance
features.text: Finished in a rich mahogany hue, it brings warmth and timeless elegance to your dining décor—because your space deserves it.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
